history.vet: The vet found nothing left to fix and raised two calls for you.

declinedFindings.summary: Add a condition rating to every tool on the shelf.
declinedFindings.reason: Nothing in your framing asks for condition scores, so adding them would be new scope.

declinedFindings.summary: Let two people edit the same booking at once.
declinedFindings.reason: You said the app is for one lender per tool, so sharing a booking is out of scope.

cards.question: Should a tool returned in the evening be bookable the next morning?

blocks.paragraph: The spec has seven morning pickups and seven evening returns, but it never says whether a tool returned tonight can be booked again tomorrow morning. This one is yours to call, because it depends on whether lenders want a night to check a tool or want it back out on loan straight away.

bullets: If a returned tool can go straight back out, each tool is borrowed more often and fewer tools are needed.
If it cannot, every tool gets a rest day, so lenders can check it but borrowers wait longer.

context.title: The line that leaves it open

blocks.quote: Each day has one pickup slot and one return slot, and every booking covers one tool for one borrower.

options.label: Let a returned tool be booked the next morning
options.consequence: Each tool is borrowed more often and fewer tools are needed, but a tool may go out before the lender has checked it.

options.label: Require a rest day between bookings
options.consequence: Every tool is checked between loans, so tools stay in good shape but borrowers wait longer and more tools are needed.

recommendation.text: Let a returned tool be booked the next morning.
recommendation.reason: Most neighbours lend tools to save others a purchase, and a quick turnaround is the common way to do that.

cards.question: Do you want past bookings kept after the tool is returned?

blocks.paragraph: The spec covers making and editing a current booking. It says nothing about what happens to that booking once the tool is back. Keeping old bookings means more storage and a new screen to browse them, so it is a call about scope.
